residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Reproduce with: b = open(PATH,"rb").read() ; z = re.subn(rb'("sha256": ")[0-9a-f]{64}', rb'\\g<1>' + b"0"*64, b, count=1) ; assert z[1] == 1 ; print(hashlib.sha256(z[0]).hexdigest())  -- then compare to artifacts[0].sha256. NOTE the backreference MUST be written \\g<1>, not \\1: with \\1 immediately followed by the first "0" of the padding, Python re reads \\100 as an OCTAL escape for "@" and silently corrupts the zeroed image, producing a digest that can never be reproduced. That bug occurred in the first build of this artifact and was caught by an in-builder round-trip assertion, not by inspection.

The other five live roots are unchanged in filtered file count (rules 88, agents 18, commands 71, hooks 270, .agents/skills 1795 - identical in both samples).

method_notes: LF normalisation is CRLF->LF only. A lone CR is NOT folded, and a file containing a NUL byte is never normalised (it is classified BINARY-DIFF).
Direction is decided by UNIQUE-LINE SET membership, not by size and not by mtime: repo_only = set(repo_lines) - set(live_lines), live_only = the mirror. Both non-empty = DIVERGED.
REORDER-ONLY exists so that a pair with the same unique line set in a different order is NOT reported as DIVERGED. It occurred 0 times, which is itself worth knowing.

A pair-instance is (edge, path). A single file can appear on more than one edge because one live tree can have two repo counterparts; distinct-path counts are reported alongside pair-instance counts so neither is mistaken for the other.

The population is deliberately the population the sync scripts can actually reach: the same 14 excluded directory names, 20 excluded file patterns and nested-foreign-repo skip that sync-from-live.ps1 applies.

INSTRUMENTS. SOURCE probe: adv0017_probe1.py, three-way line-set classification after LF normalisation (reads CONTENT). VERIFIER probe, mechanically different: adv0017_probe2.py, a git log -1 --format=%cI x live st_mtime provenance join plus a full content read of every live-larger pair (reads git METADATA and filesystem METADATA, then re-reads content by a different code path). Supporting: adv0017_blast.py (per-writer blast-radius join), adv0017_control.py (10-case both-states battery), adv0017_mutation.py (mutation of the normaliser), adv0017_validate.py (schema validation plus a 12-defect validator control). All under extensions.reproduction.scratchpad.

INCIDENT, disclosed rather than suppressed: a Windows reserved-name file at ~/.agents/skills/workflow-monitor/NUL raised ValueError from os.path.relpath twice. It was GUARDED - counted, skipped and recorded in per_writer_blast_radius - not silently swallowed, and both control batteries were re-run to 10/10 after the guard before any real number was read.
